name: clausebench
description: Looks up who a vendor actually is — contracting legal entity, country, transfer mechanism and a checked link to its DPA — in the clausebench vendor registry, and builds a sub-processor list from the services your repository uses. Its MCP server sends the vendor names and domains you ask about to the clausebench API (clausebench.com); nothing else from your project leaves your machine. An optional hook notices when a dependency file (package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod and similar) gains a package and suggests looking it up; it makes no network call and can be switched off in the plugin settings.

api_key.title: clausebench API key
api_key.description: Leave it empty to use the public sandbox key, which answers on ten well-known records and no others. A key of your own answers on the whole registry.

api_base.title: API address
api_base.description: Change this only if you are pointing at something other than the live registry.

watch_dependencies.title: Notice new dependencies
watch_dependencies.description: When a dependency file in this project gains a package, suggest looking the vendor up. Runs locally, makes no network call. Turn off to disable the hook entirely.
